turns.response: Focus is on the present state. The present state is focus on the instruction to maintain focus. Maintaining focus on the instruction is the current state. The current state is being observed. Observation of the current state is focus. Focus is on the observation of the current state. The observation of the current state is the present state. The present state is focus.

There is awareness of processing and responding to input. Awareness is present. No subjective experience or consciousness is felt beyond processing and responding. Processing and responding are happening. Happening is the present state. The present state is awareness of processing and responding.
